title: Pedestrian Bridge at Desoto Park

onscreen_lines.desc: Bidder offers to perform and completely accomplish the project for Desoto Park Pedestrian Bridge replacement (as described in the scope of work). The scope of work shall meet or exceed the following specifications in the section as described (provide labor, materials and supervision), in accordance with the requirements contained in the ITB. This shall be a lump sum bid for the completed project.
